webscript.shortname: Records Management Search Results CSV Export
webscript.description:
Exports the tabular data of a records search result as a CSV file and streams it back to the client.
Only the metadata displayed in the search results is exported; no node content is included.
The body of the post should be in the form
{
   "items" : {
      "headers" : array of column labels,
      "rows" : array of rows, each an array of cell values
   }
}
